newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR NORWAY V FINLAND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR NORWAY V FINLAND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for the World Cup group three qualifier between Norway and Finland on Wednesday:

Norway: 1-Frode Grodaas, 2-Dan Eggen, 3-Ronny Johnsen, 4-Henning Berg, 5-Stig Inge Bjoernebye, 6-Frank Strandli. 7-Erik Mykland, 8-Staale Solbakken, 9-Ole Gunnar Solskjaer, 10-Kjetil Rekdal, 11-Tore Andre Flo.
Finland: 1-Antti Niemi, 2-Marko Tuomela, 3-Sami Hyypia, 4-Jussi Nuorela, 5-Jukka Koskinen, 6-Sami Mahlio, 7-Kari Rissanen, 8-Mika Nurmela, 9-Antti Sumiala, 10-Jari Litmanen, 11-Jonatan Johansson.
